label: Solid color
blurb: Every LED holds the configured hue. The one effect QMK compiles in unconditionally.

label: Alphas / mods
blurb: Letters in the configured hue, modifiers in a second hue that drifts with speed.

label: Gradient up/down
blurb: A still hue ramp from the top row to the bottom.

label: Gradient left/right
blurb: A still hue ramp across the board.

label: Breathing
blurb: The whole board fades in and out on one hue.

label: Band (saturation)
blurb: A saturated band sweeps across a washed-out board.

label: Band (brightness)
blurb: A bright band sweeps across a dim board.

label: Pinwheel band (saturation)
blurb: The saturation band sweeps around the board's center instead of across it.

label: Pinwheel band (brightness)
blurb: The brightness band sweeps around the board's center.

label: Spiral band (saturation)
blurb: The saturation band winds outward as it turns.

label: Spiral band (brightness)
blurb: The brightness band winds outward as it turns.

label: Cycle all
blurb: The whole board moves through the spectrum together.

label: Cycle left/right
blurb: A rainbow scrolls across the board. QMK's own fallback default.

label: Cycle up/down
blurb: A rainbow scrolls from the top row to the bottom.

label: Moving chevron
blurb: A rainbow chevron marches across the board.

label: Cycle out/in
blurb: A rainbow collapses toward the board's center.

label: Cycle out/in (dual)
blurb: The same collapse, run from each half's own center.

label: Cycle pinwheel
blurb: A rainbow turns around the board's center.

label: Cycle spiral
blurb: A rainbow spirals outward from the center.

label: Dual beacon
blurb: Two hue arms sweep around the center like a lighthouse.

label: Rainbow beacon
blurb: The beacon sweep, widened into a full rainbow.

label: Rainbow pinwheels
blurb: Two rainbow arms turning in opposite directions.

label: Flower blooming
blurb: Diagonal rainbow petals that open and close.

label: Raindrops
blurb: Single keys light at random, in hues near the configured one.

label: Jellybean raindrops
blurb: Raindrops in fully random hues.

label: Hue breathing
blurb: Brightness holds; the hue swings around the configured one.

label: Hue pendulum
blurb: The hue swing sweeps across the board like a pendulum.

label: Hue wave
blurb: The hue swing travels across the board as a wave.

label: Pixel rain
blurb: Random keys blink on and off in random hues.

label: Pixel flow
blurb: Random-hue pixels stream along the LED chain.

label: Pixel fractal
blurb: A mirrored fractal pattern grows out from the middle columns.

label: Typing heatmap
blurb: Keys warm from blue to red as you type them, and cool back down. Needs the framebuffer.

label: Digital rain
blurb: Green columns fall down the board. Needs the framebuffer.

label: Reactive - simple
blurb: The key you press flares and fades. The plainest tap-reactive effect.

label: Reactive
blurb: The key you press flares and fades, shifting hue as it goes.

label: Reactive - wide
blurb: The flare spreads to the keys around the one you pressed.

label: Reactive - wide (multi)
blurb: Wide flares from several recent keys at once.

label: Reactive - cross
blurb: The flare runs down the row and column of the key you pressed.

label: Reactive - cross (multi)
blurb: Crosses from several recent keys at once.

label: Reactive - nexus
blurb: A cross that trails behind the key rather than centering on it.

label: Reactive - nexus (multi)
blurb: Nexus trails from several recent keys at once.

label: Splash
blurb: A rainbow ring expands out from the key you pressed.

label: Splash (multi)
blurb: Rings from several recent keys at once.

label: Splash - one hue
blurb: The expanding ring, in the configured hue instead of a rainbow.

label: Splash - one hue (multi)
blurb: Single-hue rings from several recent keys at once.

label: Starlight - smooth
blurb: Every key breathes on its own phase, so the board shimmers.

label: Starlight
blurb: Random keys twinkle at the configured hue.

label: Starlight - dual saturation
blurb: Twinkles vary in saturation around the configured color.

label: Starlight - dual hue
blurb: Twinkles vary in hue around the configured color.

label: Riverflow
blurb: A slow brightness ripple travels along the LED chain.
